They resemble four-legged [[Fish]] and patrol their territories in search of prey. Molduga are sensitive to sound, and they will rise out of Sand to eat whatever they can find. As a result, it is considered dangerous to enter the domain of a Molduga. Once they become aware of [[Link]]'s presence, Molduga will barrel towards and attempt to ram into him. Molduga can be fought while [[Shield Surfing]] with the help of a [[Sand Seal]]. Due to their sensitivity to loud noises, Link can strike them with [[Remote Bomb]]s or [[Bomb Arrow]]s, causing them to be stunned once they jump out of the Sand. When defeated, Molduga drops one or two [[Treasure Chest]]s containing various [[Weapon]]s, [[Molduga Fin]]s, and [[Molduga Guts]]. As part of the "[[Medicinal Molduga]]" [[Side Quest]], [[Malena]] requires [[Molduga Guts]] in order to cure her husband's illness, but none of the soldiers in [[Gerudo Town]] are willing to defeat one for her. When Link brings her Molduga Guts, she gives him a [[Gold Rupee]] as a reward. After Link defeats [[Calamity Ganon]] for the first time, he will be able to ask [[Kilton]] about Molduga. As part of his research, he has determined that four Molduga can be found in the entirety of [[Hyrule]]. Due to their size, Kilton is unable to safely approach them, so he asks Link if he could defeat all of them, allowing Kilton to analyze the scent their fluids leave behind. When Link returns to Kilton after defeating all of the Molduga, he will be able to smell them clearly, and he gives Link the [[Medal of Honor: Molduga]] as a reward. As part of {{TCB}} [[Downloadable Content]] Pack, the [[Molduking]] will appear in the [[East Barrens]]. It is a more powerful subspecies of Molduga, known to build up energy by sleeping underground for hundreds of years. ====Locations==== * [[Arbiter's Grounds]] * [[North Dragon's Exile]] * [[Southern Oasis]] * [[Toruma Dunes]] ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= TotK |type= Sub-Bosses |category= Sub-Bosses in Tears of the Kingdom |needs= * Detailed information on enemy behavior * Detailed information on the enemy's weaknesses * Information on where the enemy appears }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Molduga}} {{Stub|TotK}} Molduga reappear in {{TotK}} with the same appearance and behavior they had in {{BotW}}. They are sensitive to explosions from [[Bomb Flower]]s and [[Time Bomb]]s. They now also drop [[Molduga Jaw]]s when defeated. As part of the [[Side Quest]] "[[The Missing Owner]]", Link must save [[Isha]] from a Molduga in the [[Toruma Dunes]]. Another Molduga appears in the [[Side Quest]] "[[WANTED: Molduga]]", where Link must defeat a Molduga found in the [[East Barrens]]. ====Locations==== * [[East Barrens]] * [[Gerudo Desert]] * [[Palu Wasteland South]] * [[Toruma Dunes]] ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|AoC}} Molduga are massive [[Powerful Foe]]s that can be seen swimming through the [[Sand]] in [[Battle]]s set in the [[Gerudo Town]] [[Stage]]. During the [[Scenario]] "[[Urbosa, the Gerudo Chief]]", the [[Warrior]]s take advantage of their noise sensitivity to lure one out with the sound of [[Remote Bomb]] explosions. Defeated Molduga drop [[Molduga Fin]]s and [[Molduga Guts]]. After completing a Battle in which a Molduga was slain, the [[Warrior]]s will receive a [[Molduga Trophy]]. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= AoI |type= Bosses |category= Bosses in Age of Imprisonment |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Model and sprite image(s) of the Boss * The Boss's behavior * The Boss's weaknesses * Where the Boss appears }} {{Stub|AoI}} As in {{AoC}}, Molduga are giant [[Powerful Enemy|Powerful Enemies]] that swim in [[Sand]]. During the [[Movie]] "[[The Feint]]", [[Ganondorf]] directs a swarm of Molduga to attack [[Hyrule Castle (Great Plateau)|Hyrule Castle]] to distract the [[King of Hyrule]], [[Rauru]], as [[Gerudo Soldier]]s attack. With his powers bolstered by the aid of Queen [[Sonia]] and Princess [[Zelda]], however, Rauru generates a massive beam of [[Light]] that wipes out the swarm. During the [[Scenario]] "[[Raging Sands]]", [[Ardi]] releases one more Molduga to attack Rauru, Sonia, and Zelda directly. Defeated Molduga drop [[Molduga Fin]]s, [[Molduga Guts|Guts]], and [[Molduga Jaw|Jaws]]. At the end of a [[Battle]], the [[Warrior]]s will be awarded a [[Molduga Trophy]] for each defeated. ==Nomenclature== Molduga may pay tribute to [[Molgera]], the [[Boss]] of the [[Wind Temple]] in {{TWW}}. Molgera itself has its name derived from ''mogura'', which is Japanese for mole.{{Fact|TWW}} The four Molduga act similar to Molgera by being submerged in [[Sand]], further supporting this claim. {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== {{All Images}} File:BotW Molduga Concept Art.jpg|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Concept artwork of a Molduga File:BotW Link Fighting Molduga.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Link fighting a Molduga while riding a Sand Seal File:TotK Geoglyph Icon 4.png|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}A Geoglyph depicting a Molduga File:TotK Hyrule Compendium Molduga Picture.png|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}Hyrule Compendium Picture of a Molduga ==See Also== {{See Also| * Molduking * Monster }} {{Ref| {{Cite|This massive monster swims beneath the desert's sand.
